metadata.title: Your licence
metadata.description: Your licence key, the machines that use it and your invoices.

pending: Your key is being issued. It appears here by itself in a few seconds.
revoked: This licence is no longer active. Write to us if that looks wrong.
refunded: This licence was refunded, so its key no longer works. Write to us if that looks wrong.
usage: Activate the key with the SaaSy Land CLI on each machine you build on. Keep the key private.

commands.activate: Activates the key on this machine. Paste the key when the CLI asks for it; it stays hidden while you type.
commands.init: Generates a project in the {dir} folder. Generating a project is first use under the <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds>, so the {days}-day refund no longer applies after it.
commands.whoami: Shows your tier, the slots in use and this machine's name.
commands.deactivate: Frees this machine's slot and removes the key from it.

ci: In CI, store the key as a secret in {variable}.
changeTier: To move to a lower tier, email <mail>{email}</mail>.

buy.title: Get your licence
buy.description: One payment, lifetime core updates and no per-user fees. Every tier includes the CLI; each card says what works now and what is arriving.

notice.consent: You pay on Polar, our Merchant of Record. On the payment page you tick a box to have your licence supplied straight away, which ends your {days}-day right of withdrawal once your key is issued.
notice.refund: Until you generate a project or open a paid lesson, you can still get a full refund within {days} days. See the <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds>.
notice.agreement: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <licence>Commercial Licence</licence>.
notice.english: The payment page opens in English.

buy.alreadyActive: You already have an active licence. To upgrade, choose a higher tier on your licence page; to move to a lower one, email {email}.

chosen.title: Continue with {tier}
chosen.description: You chose {tier}. Pay once on Polar and your licence key appears here a few seconds later.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to {tier}
upgrade.description: What you have paid for {from} counts towards {tier}, so you pay only the difference, once.
upgrade.breakdown: {tier} costs you {price}, less the {credit} you have paid for your licence.
upgrade.key: Your key stays the same and then activates up to {to, plural, one {# machine} other {# machines}} instead of {from}.

activating.title: Payment received
activating.body: Your licence is being activated. This takes a few seconds, and the page updates by itself.

active.title: Your licence is active
active.body: Thank you for buying {tier}. These steps take you to your first project.

delayed.title: Activation is taking longer than usual
delayed.body: Polar has not confirmed your payment to us yet. That normally takes seconds, so check again in a minute. If your licence still has not arrived, email <mail>{email}</mail> with the checkout reference below and we will activate it by hand.

setup.title: Get started
setup.description: Each step ticks itself off once you have done it.

key.title: Copy your licence key
key.pending: Your key is being issued. It appears here in a few seconds.

activate.title: Activate the key on your machine
activate.body: Run the command in your terminal and paste the key when the CLI asks for it; it stays hidden while you type.

init.title: Generate your first project
init.body: Generating a project is first use under the <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds>: after it, the {days}-day refund no longer applies.

activations.title: Machines
activations.description: Each machine where you activate the key uses one slot. Free a slot when you stop using a machine.
activations.none: No machines have used this key yet.

agreement: The <licence>Commercial Licence</licence> covers the CLI and your rights to generated applications.

statusCard.title: Your licence
statusCard.description: View your licence key and manage your activated machines.

keyAwaitsConfirmation: Your key appears here once you confirm your email address. Open the link we sent to <address>{email}</address>.
deletion: Your {tier} licence ends with the account. Its key stops working in the CLI and the paid lessons close. Deleting refunds nothing: to withdraw from the purchase, use the withdrawal function first.
